subtitle: High-risk actions waiting for a distinct human approver. Eligible approvers can record a decision here or in a supported channel.
mechanicsBody: High-risk work stays parked until a distinct approver acts. FDAI Console records the human decision and queues it for Var; it never executes the action.
justificationRequired: Enter a justification before recording the decision.
decisionDelivered: {decision} was recorded and delivered to the approval workflow.
decisionPendingDelivery: {decision} was recorded. Durable delivery is pending and will be retried.
decisionUnavailable: This legacy or incomplete approval cannot be decided from FDAI Console.
